legs.GAME: three markets an event: two team markets and one ending in -TIE
legs.TOTAL: a ladder; each market's floor_strike is the goals line (over floor_strike)
legs.BTTS: one market an event: both teams to score
legs.TEAMTOTAL: a ladder per team; used only where the market object gives floor_strike and the team can be read from the ticker or title, else counted as unreadable

kickoff_rule: kickoff = occurrence_datetime of the GAME market minus 180 minutes; check: the GAME market closed between 100 and 135 minutes after it, else the game is dropped and counted
sample: the 60 most recently settled games of each league inside the window, never extended
series_name_rule: KX + league + GAME | TOTAL | BTTS | TEAMTOTAL; a ticker that returns no market is counted as 'no such series'
